description: Use this when the organizer wants to add events to a group calendar, change an event (time, date, place, note, repeat, skipped dates), cancel or restore an event, or rename the calendar. Needs the private organizer link and the event numbers from show_group_calendar. Changed events keep their identity and get a higher revision, so calendar apps update them on their next refresh; cancelled events stay marked as cancelled. Does not notify anyone and does not delete events.

add_events.description: New events to add, same shape as when creating, e.g. [{"title":"Tournament","date":"2026-12-12","all_day":true}].

all_day.description: true for an all-day event (no times), e.g. true.

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes instead of an end time, e.g. 90. Default 60.

end.description: Local end time HH:MM, e.g. 19:00. An end earlier than the start means the next day. Or use duration_minutes.

end_date.description: For an all-day event over several days, the last day YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), e.g. 2026-11-22.

location.description: Place in words, e.g. Field 2, Riverside Park. No links.

note.description: Short note, e.g. Bring shin guards.

repeat_weekly_until.description: Repeat every week on the same weekday until this date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), e.g. 2027-01-26.

skip_dates.description: Dates of a weekly series to leave out, e.g. ["2026-12-22"].

start.description: Local start time HH:MM in the calendar's time zone, e.g. 17:30. Omit for an all-day event.

changes.description: Changes to existing events by number, e.g. [{"event":1,"skip_dates":["2026-12-22"]},{"event":3,"cancel":true}].

all_day.description: true for an all-day event (no times), e.g. true.

cancel.description: true to cancel the event; it stays in subscribers' calendars marked cancelled, e.g. true.

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes instead of an end time, e.g. 90. Default 60.

end.description: Local end time HH:MM, e.g. 19:00. An end earlier than the start means the next day. Or use duration_minutes.

end_date.description: For an all-day event over several days, the last day YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), e.g. 2026-11-22.

event.description: The event number shown in the calendar results, e.g. 3.

location.description: Place in words, e.g. Field 2, Riverside Park. No links.

note.description: Short note, e.g. Bring shin guards.

repeat_weekly_until.description: Repeat every week on the same weekday until this date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), e.g. 2027-01-26.

restore.description: true to undo a cancellation, e.g. false.

skip_dates.description: Dates to ADD to the dates this weekly series already skips (earlier skips stay), e.g. ["2026-12-22"].

start.description: Local start time HH:MM in the calendar's time zone, e.g. 17:30. Omit for an all-day event.

unskip_dates.description: Skipped dates of a weekly series to put back, e.g. ["2026-12-22"].

description.description: New description, e.g. Winter indoor schedule.

manage_link.description: The private organizer link returned when the calendar was made, e.g. https://calendar-feed.zovo.one/m/<id>/<key>.

name.description: New calendar name, e.g. U12 practice (winter).

name: update_group_calendar
title: Update group calendar
